Rhiw Wood Treehouses
Nestled in the heart of ancient Welsh Woodland, Rhiw Wood is an enchanting escape where nature takes centre stage. Time slows down here, allowing you to reconnect with tranquillity and the beauty of lush greenery.
​
At Rhiw Wood, we aim to provide an unforgettable retreat that immerses guests in the wonders of the natural world. Whether you're seeking serenity or adventure, our Treehouses are a haven for rest, rejuvenation, and reconnection with nature and yourself.
Book Oolert
Book Cnocell
The Rhiw Wood Experience
​ Blending luxurious comfort with untouched wilderness, each Treehouse is thoughtfully designed to complement the natural surroundings. With modern amenities, inviting interiors, and Hot Tubs, our spaces offer the perfect sanctuary after exploring the breathtaking landscapes nearby.
​
Meet Your Hosts
Run by Lyndon, Emma, and their family, Rhiw Wood is rooted in generations of farming heritage in the hills of Radnorshire. Their love for the land and local culture inspired them to create these magical Treehouses, offering guests an authentic and immersive experience.
From mythical stories like the legend of Silver John to glimpses of the old local language, the family delights in sharing the area's rich history and traditions. Emma's hospitality expertise ensures every guest feels welcome, cared for, and at home.
Unplug and Reconnect
Step away from the hustle and bustle of daily life, immerse yourself in the slower pace of rural Wales, and soak in the peace of the ancient woodlands. Whether exploring woodland trails, enjoying the views, or simply relaxing by the fire, Rhiw Wood is a place to create memories that last a lifetime.
Book Your Stay Today
Experience the magic of Rhiw Wood Treehouses. Escape, unwind, and rediscover the joy of nature. Book your stay today and unlock an extraordinary retreat filled with comfort, tranquillity, and wonder.

Treehouses | Rhiw Wood Treehouses
top of page
Your Luxury Treehouse Adventure Awaits
Discover the unparalleled charm of Rhiw Wood Treehouses, your ultimate retreat in the heart of Mid Wales. Nestled amidst serene woodlands, our two luxurious Treehouses Oolert and Cnocell y Coed offer a tranquil escape for families, couples, and groups.​
Perfect for Every Occasion
Each Treehouse sleeps up to 7 guests, making them ideal for intimate gatherings or extended stays with loved ones. Planning a large group getaway? Book both Treehouses for a combined capacity of 14 guests, with just 80 meters separating them close enough for shared moments yet far enough for privacy.
​
​Inspired by Nature
Our Treehouses take their names from the rich Welsh language:
Oolert (meaning " baby Owl ") is truly special to us as we share the woods with our resident owls
Cnocell y Coed (meaning " Woodpecker ") can often be heard working away in the woods, just outside your Treehouse
​
Which Treehouse Will You Choose?
Both Oolert and Cnocell y Coed offer the same luxurious amenities, including a private Hot Tub, a fully equipped kitchen and dining area, and a walk-in waterfall shower.
Each Treehouse offers its unique charm:
Oolert : Relax in a balcony Hot Tub with stunning elevated views, complemented by a light, airy wood interior and a mix of rustic and modern furnishings. The space also includes a cosy den with a day bed and dining area.
Cnocell y Coed : Relax in the tranquil Den with a hammock and benches, soak in the fairy-lit Hot Tub. The Master Bedroom features an additional TV for extra relaxation. Unwind on the cosy swing seat surrounded by warm, exposed wooden walls.

Frequently Asked Questions
Why are treehouse holidays so popular with families?
Treehouse holidays offer something truly different from a traditional family break. At Rhiw Wood Treehouses, children can swap screens for woodland adventures, meet friendly farm animals, hunt for fossils and enjoy the freedom of nature, while parents relax in peaceful surroundings. With luxury accommodation, private hot tubs and plenty of space to spend quality time together, it s a holiday the whole family can enjoy.
Are your treehouses suitable for children of all ages?
Yes. Our treehouses are designed with families in mind and welcome children of all ages. Whether you re travelling with a baby, toddlers or older children, you ll find comfortable family accommodation and plenty of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors together. Parents should supervise young children, particularly around the treehouse steps, balconies and hot tub.
What family activities are available during a stay?
There s plenty to keep the whole family entertained during your stay. Children love meeting our Highland cows and Kunekune pigs, exploring the woodland, searching for fossils in our private quarry and discovering local wildlife. You ll also find board games, books and arts and crafts hampers in the treehouses, while nearby attractions offer lakes, castles, walking trails and family-friendly days out.
Can children meet the Highland cows?
Absolutely. Meeting our Highland cows is one of the highlights of a stay at Rhiw Wood Treehouses. Children can help groom these gentle animals, learn about how they re cared for and take plenty of memorable photos. It s a wonderful hands-on experience that helps children connect with nature and life on a working farm.
What animals can children see at Rhiw Wood?
Alongside our much-loved Highland cows, children can meet our friendly Kunekune pigs, Roger and Ralphy, and depending on the season, may also spot sheep, birds, butterflies and other wildlife around the woodland. Every visit offers something different, making each stay an exciting opportunity to experience nature up close.
Is there space for children to play safely?
Yes. Rhiw Wood is surrounded by peaceful woodland and open countryside, giving families plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors together. Children can explore nature, play games and discover wildlife while remaining close to the Treehouse. As we re a working farm, we always recommend that children are supervised by an adult during outdoor activities.
What can families do if it rains?
Rainy days can be just as enjoyable at Rhiw Wood. Relax inside your cosy Treehouse with board games, books, Smart TV and family films, or get creative with the arts and crafts hamper. You can also enjoy the covered outdoor areas, soak in the private hot tub or visit nearby attractions, cafés and museums if you d like to explore further.
Are travel cots and highchairs available?
es. We can provide travel cots and highchairs to make travelling with little ones easier. We recommend requesting these when booking so everything is ready for your arrival, allowing you to pack lighter and settle in straight away.
How many people can stay in each Treehouse?
Each of our luxury Treehouses sleeps up to seven guests, making them ideal for families or small groups. If you re planning a larger family gathering, both Treehouses can be booked together to accommodate up to 14 guests while still giving everyone plenty of space and privacy.
What should families pack for a Treehouse holiday?
We provide most of the essentials, including bed linen, towels, bathrobes and a fully equipped kitchen, so there s no need to overpack. We recommend bringing comfortable outdoor clothing, sturdy footwear for exploring the woodland, swimwear for the hot tub, toiletries, favourite snacks and any baby essentials you may need. Don t forget a camera—you ll want to capture memories of meeting the Highland cows and exploring beautiful Mid Wales.
How many people can each Treehouse accommodate?
Both Oolert and Cnocell y Coed can accommodate up to 7 guests. For larger groups, you can book both Treehouses, which are 80 meters apart, to host up to 14 people.
